name: Research Brief
summary: What did the last research question answer, and from how many sources?
description: Reads the latest stored research answer and shows its summary, the number of sources behind it, and when it was answered. A pure read of the local research store: no endpoint call, no model call, and no network.
highlights: The latest stored answer in one line
Source count and the time it was answered
Reads the local research store only; never calls a model
